record.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Canine Immune-mediated Hemolytic Anemia Induced by Babesia gibsoni
record.abstract: Canine immune-mediated hemolytic anemia(IMHA)is a kind of hemolytic anemia associated with self-erythrocyte antibodies,the etiology can be divided into primary and secondary causes.This article focused on diagnosis,treatment and prognosis of canine a case of IMHA induced by Babesia gibsoni.

screening.species: B. gibsoni (confirmed by case diagnosis; method not stated)
screening.rationale: Case of immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia secondary to B. gibsoni, a distinct immune-mediated syndrome, with discussion of diagnosis, treatment and prognosis.
